report.status_line: Static water tank critically low with one day of supply remaining; 3 EVA headset microphones and 2 ATVs non-functional.

concerns.title: Depleted Static Water Reserves and Lack of Hot Water
concerns.detail: The static water tank has dropped to Less than 10cm, with the crew reporting tomorrow is the last day with sufficient water supplies under water-saving measures. Additionally, hot water has still not been attained.

concerns.title: Defective EVA Headset Microphones
concerns.detail: Testing concluded that the microphones on 3 out of 6 EVA headsets are defective and not functioning, restricting communications capability on EVAs.

concerns.title: Mobility Impairments from ATV Malfunctions
concerns.detail: ATV 5 failed to start and is not functioning, while ATV 3 starts but shuts down immediately once the throttle is released.

crew_actions: Quarantine defective headsets and restrict EVA team sizes to members with verified functional communications gear.
Troubleshoot ATV 3 throttle issues and consult available technical documentation for ATV 5.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Confirm the water resupply schedule and approve scheduling a water recovery activity for tomorrow's EVA.
decisions_for_earth.why: The static water tank reading is Less than 10cm and the crew identified tomorrow as the final day of sufficient supplies.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve a near-future resupply of EVA communications equipment including at least 3 replacement headsets.
decisions_for_earth.why: Three of six headset microphones are non-functional, which limits safe crew communications during surface operations.

report.message_to_earth: Status is caution due to critically low water supplies. On 2015-01-15, static tank water dropped to less than 10cm, leaving tomorrow as the final day with sufficient water under rationing. ATV 5 failed to start, ATV 3 shuts down when throttle is released, and 3 out of 6 EVA headset microphones are defective. The crew is enforcing water-saving protocols and isolating defective equipment. Propane is at 40%, diesel is at 75%, and other station systems are nominal, though hot water is not attained. Please confirm the water resupply delivery and approve a water recovery EVA by tomorrow morning. Next report will be submitted tomorrow evening.
